# Google Play checks: R8 and edge-to-edge

Two findings Google Play Console showed for every Android app at release 11.23, what they mean, and what Omni does about them.

## DEX code optimization (obfuscation)

Play scores each App Bundle's code optimization by category and limits the visibility and publishing of apps with any category under 25%. Release 11.23 scored **1% obfuscation** because R8 was off (`enableMinifyInReleaseBuilds: false`, kept from the SDK 57 template during the SDK 58 upgrade).

Release builds of all five apps now run R8 with `proguard-android-optimize.txt`. It is set in `packages/config-plugins/src/app-config.js` (`expo-build-properties` → `android.enableMinifyInReleaseBuilds: true`) and guarded by `apps/omni/__tests__/app-config.test.ts`. Debug and dev-client builds are not minified.

### Keep rules

R8 renames and removes anything nothing references directly. Code that reaches a class, method or field **by name** (reflection, JNI, a class name saved to disk) breaks unless a keep rule covers it. Most native libraries ship their own rules; Omni adds rules (`androidKeepRules` in `app-config.js`) only for code that ships none.

| Library                                                                   | Covered by                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| React Native, Reanimated, Worklets, Screens, SVG                          | Their consumer rules (`@DoNotStrip`, native modules, `@ReactProp` setters)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Notifee (bridge and `app.notifee:core`)                                   | Its consumer rules (`@KeepForSdk`, ReactHost lookups, EventBus, WorkManager)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| LiveKit, LiveKit WebRTC                                                   | Their consumer rules (`com.livekit.**`, `livekit.org.webrtc.**`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Sentry Android, MapLibre Android SDK, androidx.credentials (passkeys)     | Rules inside their AARs                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Nitro Modules, MMKV                                                       | Every class the C++ side names carries `@Keep` and `@DoNotStrip`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Expo modules (`expo`, `expo-modules-core`, image, task-manager, updates…) | Their consumer rules                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| CallKeep                                                                  | No reflection; its `ConnectionService` is declared in the manifest, which keeps it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| BLE manager, expo-localization                                            | Reflection on Android framework classes only (never renamed)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| WebView                                                                   | `@JavascriptInterface` methods are kept by AGP's default rules                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Gesture handler                                                           | Falls back when its generated `ReactModuleInfoProvider` is not found                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| **expo-location** (Omni rule)                                             | expo-task-manager restores `LocationTaskConsumer` by the class name it saved: `-keep class expo.modules.location.** { *; }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| **countly-sdk-react-native-bridge** (Omni rule)                           | The bridge reads Countly SDK classes, methods and private fields by name: `-keep class ly.count.android.sdk.** { *; }`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **@maplibre/maplibre-react-native** (Omni rule)                           | Its surface-view detach guard swaps `MapLibreSurfaceView.detachedListener` and reads `renderThread` by name; without them the guard silently stays off                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| **react-native-keyboard-controller** (Omni rule)                          | Looks `ReactNestedScrollView` and `getScrollEnabled()` up by name                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| **Expo module enums** (Omni rule)                                         | Expo passes an enum to and from JavaScript by its single instance field (`DigestAlgorithm.SHA256` crosses as `"SHA-256"`). The Expo modules runtime keeps that field only for enums implementing its `Enumerable`; expo-crypto's `DigestAlgorithm` and `DigestOptions.Encoding` and expo-sqlite's `SQLAction` do not (the runtime logs a warning for each). Without the field the conversion matches entry names (`SHA256`, `HEX`) instead, so hashing for SSO PKCE and the personal-lock verifier would fail: `-keepclassmembers,allowobfuscation enum expo.modules.** { !static <fields>; }` |
| **LiveKit WebRTC** (Omni rule)                                            | `-dontwarn livekit.org.jni_zero.JniZeroJni`: the published library lacks that class and only the uncalled `JniZero.setJniClassLoader` names it; R8 stops on missing classes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |

Classes with `native` methods keep their names through AGP's default rules, so JNI symbol lookup (`Java_<class>_<method>`) keeps working.

### Adding or upgrading a native library

1. Search its Android sources for `Class.forName`, `getDeclaredField`, `getDeclaredMethod`, `getMethod(`, `loadClass(` and JSON mapping of its own classes (Gson `fromJson`), and its C++ for `kJavaDescriptor`/`FindClass`.
2. Look for rules it ships: `consumerProguardFiles` in its `android/build.gradle`, or `proguard.txt` in its AAR (`unzip -l <aar> | grep proguard.txt`; Gradle keeps AARs under `~/.gradle/caches/modules-2/files-2.1`).
3. If it reflects on its own (or another library's) classes and ships no rule for that, add the narrowest rule to `androidKeepRules` with a `#` comment naming the library and why, add it to the test, and add a row above.
4. Build a release APK (`APP_VARIANT=responder APP_ENV=production expo prebuild --clean --platform android`, then `./gradlew :app:assembleRelease` in `apps/omni/android`) and run it: R8 problems show up as `ClassNotFoundException`/`NoSuchFieldException` at runtime, not at build time. Responder has every native module the other apps have.

### Resource shrinking stays off

`enableShrinkResourcesInReleaseBuilds: false`. The notification channels and the in-call audio module find their sounds in `res/raw` by name at runtime (`getIdentifier`), which the resource shrinker cannot see, so it would strip them.

### Crash reports

- **Google Play:** the App Bundle carries R8's mapping file (`BUNDLE-METADATA/com.android.tools.build.obfuscation/proguard.map`), so Android vitals stack traces are deobfuscated without an upload.
- **Sentry:** JavaScript errors are unaffected (source maps). Java/Kotlin frames of native crashes arrive with obfuscated class and method names (line numbers stay: Sentry's rules keep `LineNumberTable`). Automatic mapping upload needs the Sentry Android Gradle plugin, which the Sentry Expo plugin only offers as `experimental_android`, so it stays off (no experimental features). To read a native frame, take the mapping out of that release's AAB (`unzip -p <app>.aab BUNDLE-METADATA/com.android.tools.build.obfuscation/proguard.map > mapping.txt`) and run `retrace mapping.txt stack.txt` (Android SDK `cmdline-tools/latest/bin/retrace`).

## Edge-to-edge: deprecated APIs or parameters

Play lists the deprecated window APIs the app's code references (`Window.setStatusBarColor`, `setNavigationBarColor`, `getStatusBarColor`, `getNavigationBarColor`, `LAYOUT_IN_DISPLAY_CUTOUT_MODE_*`) and the classes that call them. It scans the compiled code, so a reference counts even when it never runs.

None of the call sites are in Omni's code. A scan of the Responder APK (`dexdump -d`, November 2026, SDK 58) found them only in libraries:

| Caller                                                                                                  | Runs on Android 15+?                                                 |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `androidx.activity.EdgeToEdgeApi23/26/28/29/30`, `androidx.core.view.WindowCompat`                      | No: the pre-Android 15 paths of `enableEdgeToEdge()`                 |
| `androidx.core.splashscreen.SplashScreen$Impl31`                                                        | Splash theme only                                                    |
| `com.google.android.material` (`BottomSheetDialog`, `SheetDialog`, `EdgeToEdgeUtils`, `NavigationView`) | Material Components internals                                        |
| `com.facebook.react.views.view.WindowUtilKt` (React Native core)                                        | No: React Native's own edge-to-edge setup for older Android versions |
| `expo.modules.navigationbar` (expo-navigation-bar)                                                      | No: guarded to Android 9 and older                                   |
| `com.reactnativekeyboardcontroller.modules.statusbar` (react-native-keyboard-controller)                | Only if JavaScript sets a status bar colour; Omni never does         |

Omni's JavaScript sets no status or navigation bar colours (React Native 0.88 removed `StatusBar.setBackgroundColor`/`setTranslucent`), and the `expo-navigation-bar` plugin gets only `hidden` (the pre-edge-to-edge `position` and `behavior` options were dropped). The finding is a recommendation without a deadline. It clears as React Native, Expo and androidx remove the old paths; recheck it after each Expo SDK upgrade with the same scan:

```bash
unzip -o app-release.apk 'classes*.dex' -d /tmp/dex
for f in /tmp/dex/classes*.dex; do "$ANDROID_HOME"/build-tools/<version>/dexdump -d "$f"; done \
  | grep -E 'Landroid/view/Window;\.(set|get)(StatusBar|NavigationBar)' | sort -u
```

Run it on a build without R8 (debug or dev client) to read the caller names; in a release build most are renamed.
